up: Retrieve all distinct molecules reported in the document with the ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL4419170. Return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, molecule type, and the source compound ID (if available) for these molecules.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.molecule_type, cr.src_compound_id FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4419170'
